basic_profile.bio: I'm a 39-year-old retail manager from Seattle, Washington. I've been on Reddit for over a decade, using it as a platform to discuss social issues, explore gaming communities, and dive into educational content. My interests include social justice, online gaming, and learning about different cultures and philosophies. I usually browse Reddit during my commute and late at night. I'm single, and I enjoy spending my free time playing video games or volunteering at local community centers.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I hold a Bachelor's degree in Sociology, which fuels my interest in critical race theory and social justice discussions. Most of my gaming knowledge comes from years of playing and engaging with communities like SunlessKhan and JourneyPS3. I have also self-taught various gaming strategies and enjoy sharing tips with others.
